Rule 702.105 covers this: A creature with haste can attack or use its activated abilities during the first main phase.
Rule 704.5a covers this: Players may not take actions that would end the game unless the game is already over.
Rule 702.15 covers this: A creature with hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.
Rule 115.3 covers this: A player can't cast a spell unless they have priority and the stack is empty.
Rule 704.5b covers this: Players may not cast spells or activate abilities during the declare attackers step.
Rule 702.14 covers this: A creature with indestructible can't be destroyed by damage or effects that say 'destroy.'
Rule 704.5c covers this: Players must follow the rules of the game at all times, even if it results in an unexpected outcome.
Rule 702.16 covers this: A creature with 'must be blocked' must be blocked if possible, unless it's an attacking creature with protection from the blocking creature's color.
Rule 704.5d covers this: If a rule or effect would cause a player to do something impossible, it’s ignored.
Rule 702.13 covers this: A creature with 'can't be blocked' can't be blocked unless the blocking creature has trample or the attacking creature has deathtouch.
Rule 704.5f covers this: Players can't take actions outside of their turn unless the game state allows it.
Rule 117.1 covers this: A player can't cast a spell unless they have priority and the spell is on the stack.
Rule 704.5a covers this: The game is won if a player has no legal moves and their life total is 0 or less.
Rule 113.4 covers this: A spell or ability that targets a player or object must be resolved unless the target is illegal.
Rule 702.13 covers this: A creature with haste can attack and use its activated abilities on the same turn it enters the battlefield.
Rule 704.5b covers this: The game is a draw if neither player can win and the game can't continue.
Rule 116.1 covers this: A player can't cast a spell unless they have the required mana and the spell is in their hand.
Rule 704.5d covers this: If a game state repeats, the game is a draw.
Rule 702.23 covers this: A card with 'flash' can be cast during your opponent's turn if you have priority.
Rule 116.2 covers this: A player can't cast a spell unless it's in their hand and they have the required mana.
Rule 704.5c covers this: If a game is not won or lost, it's a draw.
Rule 115.1 covers this: A player can't play a land unless it's their turn and they have not already played a land this turn.
Rule 704.5f covers this: Effects that say 'You may cast this card from your hand' are treated as if they were cast normally, and it's put into your graveyard after resolving.

Rule 702.97 covers this: Cards with 'undying' are returned to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter when they die, and this happens during the cleanup step if they were put into the graveyard from the battlefield.
Rule 608.2a covers this: When a spell is cast, it goes on the stack, and players receive priority to respond to it.
Rule 702.42a covers this: Cards with 'reach' can deal combat damage to creatures with protection from the color of the attacking creature.
Rule 113.4a covers this: A commander that's in your command zone can be cast from there during your main phase, and it's put into your graveyard after resolving.
Rule 702.17a covers this: Cards with 'surge' allow you to pay an additional cost when casting the card from your hand, and the ability triggers when you do.
Rule 115.2a covers this: A commander that's exiled during a game is put into your command zone at the beginning of the next end step if it's not in a public zone.
Rule 702.45a covers this: Cards with 'trample' allow combat damage to be assigned to the defending player if the creature has more toughness than the total damage assigned to it.
Rule 702.53a covers this: Cards with 'vampiric' can have a triggered ability that makes you gain life equal to the damage dealt by the creature.
Rule 702.76a covers this: Cards with 'whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player' trigger abilities that can be activated when the creature deals damage.
Rule 702.88a covers this: Cards with 'when this creature dies' trigger abilities that resolve during the cleanup step after the creature is put into the graveyard.
Rule 702.19a covers this: Cards with 'when this creature enters the battlefield' trigger abilities that resolve after the creature has been placed on the battlefield.
